method.note: Frequency bands and sustained-signal time are full-mix acoustic proxies. They do not establish instrument identity or replace the validated stem onset measurement.

limitations: The full mix cannot prove that low-band energy is a bass instrument.
Noise type, subjective attack, spatial impression, and loop naturalness require listening review.
The 0.464 second bass onset is cited from the validated stem analysis, not inferred from this full-mix calculation.
